en.summary: GAAP net revenue fell 15.6% year over year and Net Bookings fell 18.3%. Weaker full-game sales accounted for most of the revenue decline, while the operating loss widened and cash flow weakened. On November 9, management maintained its FY2027 Net Bookings range of $8.0–$8.2 billion, with sales after the launch of Grand Theft Auto VI an important factor.
findings: GAAP net revenue was $1.497 billion, down 15.6%, while Net Bookings were $1.601 billion, down 18.3%. Bookings track products and services sold during the period. The release reconciles bookings and reported revenue through deferred net revenue.

Gross margin increased to 57.5%, but the operating loss widened from $98.0 million to $117.5 million. The net loss narrowed from $133.9 million to $54.0 million, helped by a $57.9 million tax benefit versus an $18.4 million provision a year earlier.

Quarterly operating cash flow moved from a $128.4 million inflow to a $4.7 million outflow, and cash capital purchases rose to $138.3 million. Calculated free cash flow was negative $143.0 million. Standalone cash measures use the six-month amounts less first-quarter amounts from the same fiscal year.

Full-game and other revenue fell $211.1 million, accounting for roughly three-quarters of the total revenue decline. Management attributed that category’s decline primarily to Borderlands and Mafia. The next quarter’s release can show how much of the change comes from the prior-year comparison and what the new slate contributes.

Recurrent consumer spending revenue fell from $1.276 billion to $1.210 billion. Its share of revenue rose from 71.9% to 80.8% because full-game sales fell faster. Management highlighted Color Block Jam and Match Factory! as drivers of the decline, so absolute revenue is useful alongside the mix percentage.

Management guided to Q3 Net Bookings of $3.35–$3.50 billion and listed November 19 as the planned Grand Theft Auto VI launch date in its November 9 release. Timely title delivery and demand on current-generation consoles are material outlook assumptions. Track actual bookings, revenue recognition and cash collection in the next disclosure.

segments.name: Rockstar and console releases
segments.text: Higher digital revenue from the existing Grand Theft Auto series partly offset weakness in other titles. For the next quarter’s launch, console bookings, full-game revenue and deferred revenue can help distinguish launch sales from subsequent recognition.

segments.name: Mobile and recurrent consumer spending
segments.text: Mobile titles contribute to ongoing monetization through in-game purchases and advertising. Take-Two pointed to Color Block Jam and Match Factory! as the principal reasons recurrent spending revenue fell. Watch mobile revenue together with the absolute recurrent spending figure.

follow_ups.question: How does the Grand Theft Auto VI launch translate into reported results?
follow_ups.update: Compare Q3 bookings and revenue with the November guidance and monitor console performance and deferred revenue.

follow_ups.question: Can recurrent consumer spending revenue return to growth?
follow_ups.update: Compare mobile revenue and recurrent spending revenue, and look for disclosures on the titles driving the movement and player acquisition costs.

follow_ups.question: When do new releases translate into stronger free cash flow?
follow_ups.update: Subtract current cumulative cash flows from the next same-fiscal-year totals to compare quarterly operating cash flow, capital purchases and working capital.

limitations: Analysis uses the linked official materials. Source coverage and unreconciled or unavailable quarterly measures are shown separately.
Financial values and guidance come from the verified reporting packet. Business commentary interprets the cited disclosures.
No pre-release consensus snapshot was preserved.

metrics.label: GAAP gross margin
metrics.definition: GAAP gross profit divided by quarterly revenue.

metrics.label: Calculated free cash flow
metrics.definition: Standalone quarterly operating cash flow less cash capital purchases.

metrics.label: Net Bookings
metrics.definition: Issuer operating metric for products and services sold digitally or sold into physical retail during the period.

metrics.label: Recurrent consumer spending revenue
metrics.definition: Recognized revenue from virtual currency, add-on content, in-game purchases and advertising.
